aesthetic_art deco.title: Art Deco
aesthetic_art deco.description: You're drawn to glamour, sophistication, and timeless elegance. Your aesthetic soulmate is Art Deco — characterized by geometric patterns, luxurious materials, and bold contrasts. You appreciate the finer things in life and love to surround yourself with beauty that makes a statement.

aesthetic_earthy.title: Earthy Natural
aesthetic_earthy.description: You find peace in nature and authenticity. Your aesthetic soulmate is Earthy Natural — warm tones, organic materials, and a connection to the earth. You value sustainability and simplicity, finding beauty in the natural world around you.

aesthetic_cozy.title: Cozy Minimalist
aesthetic_cozy.description: Comfort and warmth define your style. Your aesthetic soulmate is Cozy Minimalist — soft textures, muted colors, and spaces that feel like a warm embrace. You prioritize emotional comfort and create environments that feel safe and inviting.

aesthetic_edgy.title: Edgy Industrial
aesthetic_edgy.description: You march to the beat of your own drum. Your aesthetic soulmate is Edgy Industrial — raw textures, bold contrasts, and unconventional beauty. You're drawn to the underground, the vintage, and the creatively rebellious.
